    """Return (vertical-side, horizontal-side) for a solid one-cell L, else None."""
    ys = [y for y, x in pts]
    xs = [x for y, x in pts]

    h, w = y1 - y0 + 1, x1 - x0 + 1

    x0 = min(x for y, x in pts)

            aligned.append(items)
    candidates = aligned if aligned else repeated

        items,
